sources.limitations: Official department page explicitly invites public contact at this address concerning equity and systemic inequities in the criminal legal system. Do not infer a general medical complaint channel. Public defenders serve eligible clients in matters within their statutory or contracted remit; the address is not an independent medical-abuse investigation or general civil legal advice channel. Reconfirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction, eligibility and channel purpose before use. Do not send confidential information by ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
